title: Decide what comes next in a Kanban team
summary: In Kanban, work flows continuously. A regular replenishment meeting decides what enters the board next, so the team always works on the most valuable items.

beginner: Hold a short meeting weekly or when the 'ready' column runs low.
Review the options and the latest priorities.
Choose the next items and check they are clear enough to start.
Respect work-in-progress limits; do not overload the board.
Tell stakeholders what was chosen and what was not.
intermediate: Hold regular replenishment with clear criteria.
Use cycle time to set expectations.
experienced: Use classes of service for urgent and fixed-date work.
Balance new features, fixes and technical health.

toolExamples.jira: Use a Kanban board with column limits.
toolExamples.trello: Use a 'ready' list with a card limit.
toolExamples.linear: Use triage to choose what enters the backlog.
